mapper.select: select * from order_item where order_id=#{orderId} and is_deleted=0 order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into order_item ( id, order_id, sku_id, sku_name, thumb_img, sku_price, sku_num ) values ( #{id}, #{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{skuName}, #{thumbImg}, #{skuPrice}, #{skuNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT oi.sku_id FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status IN (1, 2, 3) -- 已支付、已发货、已完成 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.category3_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS purchaseCount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON oi.sku_id = ps.id INNER JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status IN (1, 2, 3) -- 已支付、已发货、已完成 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.category3_id ORDER BY purchaseCount DESC
